payload.body: hv, 24 Oct: cc builds ST0008, Molt from brew (dev, opt and brew trees). The spec is intent/st/ST0008/design.md, read it first; the ACs are in acceptance.md. Build order: WP01, then 02, 03, 04, with 05 being vc's and hv's. Put the install and tree-identity code in a new lib/install.sh, sourced by bin/molt, rather than growing lib/molt.sh. dc is landing issue 0044 in lib/molt.sh, agent.sh, desktop.sh, keys.sh and ssh.sh right now, uncommitted, so don't edit those until I tell you 0044 is in. Work on main in this checkout, commit by pathspec, your own paths only, one WP per commit or a few, each with its tests. Ask intent-vc for a slot before any bats run. Run the suite under both bashes before you call a WP done, then send me the commit ids and I validate and push. Take any design question to me, not round it.
